messages:
marco: flagging a scope cliff risk for the inference roadmap. lots of v1 nice-to-haves creeping into the MVP checklist.

anya: agreed. list I'm seeing: model-pinning UI, advanced routing policies, quantization tooling, per-route cost dashboards. all valuable but heavy.

leo: engineering headcount is fixed this sprint. if we keep all that in MVP we push GA by ~3w. we should pick razor-edge MVP and move rest to v1.

taylor: customer signals: early adopters care most about reliability, predictable latency, and basic RBAC. advanced cost dashboards are secondary for pilot.

oscar: proposal: define "MVP-lite" with acceptance gates: 1) Basic auth + RBAC, 2) model selection + pinning via API (no UI), 3) SLOs + smoke observability, 4) fallback routing to a cheaper model. Everything else -> v1.

marco: concrete trade: keep model-pinning API but move model-pinning UI to v1. keep routing policy basic: region->model, drop weighted traffic splits until v1.

anya: also callout: Optimize features (quantization recommendation engine) can be shipped as an advisory report in MVP instead of runtime integration.

leo: timeline impact: MVP-lite + current sprint -> pilot in 10 business days. Full set -> pilot in 4w. which do we prefer?

taylor: product POV: go MVP-lite for pilot. get customer feedback fast. ship the heavy UX + analytics in v1.

oscar: ops ask: if we move some automation out of MVP, we need an oncall playbook for manual fallbacks. I'll draft it.

nina: QA: we'll run a targeted perf suite on MVP-lite flows, plus a staged rollout for pilot tenants. I'll add tests for fallback routing and model pin API.

marco: decision: MVP-lite. milestone plan: pilot gate (MVP-lite) in 10d; v1 feature freeze in 6w; GA target in 10w.

anya: next steps:
- oscar: publish runbook + manual fallback doc (48h)
- nina: perf + staged rollout tests (72h)
- leo: move UI items to v1 epic and update board (EOD)
- taylor: update pilot customers with revised scope and success criteria (today)
- calendar-bot: create milestone check-in next Monday 09:30

calendar-bot: "Event created: Roadmap scope check-in  Monday 09:30"

marco: resolving thread for now. we'll re-open if any stakeholder pushes to keep heavy features in MVP. :white_check_mark:
